shots.say: Protect your account with two-factor authentication. It takes about a minute.
shots.caption: Turn on two-factor authentication

shots.say: Open your authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or One Password, and scan the QR code.
shots.caption: Scan it with your authenticator app

shots.say: Enter the six digit code from the app, and tap Verify and enable.
shots.caption: Enter the code → Verify & enable

shots.say: Now the part people skip. These ten recovery codes are shown only once. Copy them, keep them somewhere safe, then press Done.
shots.caption: Save your recovery codes

shots.say: From now on, signing in takes your password and a code from your app. A stolen password alone won't get anyone in.
shots.caption: Password + code from your app

shots.say: Prefer Face ID or a fingerprint? Add a passkey, and use it at sign in instead of typing a code.
shots.caption: Or add a passkey

shots.say: One minute now keeps your account safe.
shots.caption: One minute, much safer
